cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(polaris_volk_link_regression LANGUAGES C CXX)
    enable_testing()
    include(CheckIPOSupported)
    check_ipo_supported(RESULT ipo_supported OUTPUT ipo_error)
    if(NOT ipo_supported)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "This regression requires LTO: ${ipo_error}")
    endif()
    set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION ON)
    get_filename_component(polaris_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
    # OFF reproduces the old collision. Normal builds reuse the production target.
    option(VOLK_NAMESPACE "Use volk's C++ namespace" ON)
    set(VOLK_INSTALL OFF)
    add_subdirectory("${polaris_root}/third-party/Granite/third_party/volk" volk)
    set(polaris_volk_fixture_libraries volk)
else()
    set(polaris_volk_fixture_libraries granite-volk granite-volk-headers)
endif()

find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
add_library(polaris_test_vulkan_loader SHARED fake_loader.cpp)
target_include_directories(polaris_test_vulkan_loader PRIVATE ${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIRS})
set_target_properties(polaris_test_vulkan_loader PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET default)
target_compile_features(polaris_test_vulkan_loader PRIVATE cxx_std_17)

add_executable(test_volk_link host_calls.cpp volk_calls.cpp)
target_compile_features(test_volk_link PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(test_volk_link PRIVATE ${polaris_volk_fixture_libraries} polaris_test_vulkan_loader)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_link_options(test_volk_link PRIVATE -Werror=lto-type-mismatch)
endif()
add_test(NAME test_volk_link COMMAND test_volk_link)
set_tests_properties(test_volk_link PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 10)

if(DEFINED POLARIS_PYROWAVE_SCALER_SOURCE_DIR)
    add_executable(test_pyrowave_shader_types shader_types.cpp)
    target_compile_features(test_pyrowave_shader_types PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
    target_include_directories(test_pyrowave_shader_types PRIVATE
        "${POLARIS_PYROWAVE_SCALER_SOURCE_DIR}"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third-party/pyrowave/shaders")
    add_test(NAME test_pyrowave_shader_types COMMAND test_pyrowave_shader_types)
    set_tests_properties(test_pyrowave_shader_types PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 10)
endif()
